name: sqlharness_watch
description: Poll a bounded query passing the static visible-effects text check until or untilUnchanged, within interval/maxDuration bounds. Poll a bounded query until its stop condition or duration limit. Poll output has no continuation; inspect emitted polls, source omissions, and projection omissions in this response.

sql.description: Inline SQL, at most 1 MiB. Exactly one of sql or file.

file.description: SQL file under an operator input root. Exactly one of sql or file.

parameters.description: Scalar values: culture-invariant text or JSON null. Non-scalar parameter inputs are unsupported by this engine.

until.description: Stop predicate on the first row. Exactly one of until or untilUnchanged.

untilUnchanged.description: Stop after N unchanged polls. Exactly one of until or untilUnchanged; default 3.

interval.description: Poll interval like 30s (s/m/h suffix, at most 24h). Default 30s.

maxDuration.description: Maximum watch time like 15m (s/m/h suffix, at most 24h). Default 15m.

maxResultBytes.description: Result text: 4096..1048576 bytes; default 65536; capped by process limit.

name: sqlharness_compare
description: Compare baseline/candidate measurements and observed rows. subject and textual scope follow the frozen compare.requireContext policy reported by capabilities; request-scoped target selects the database. Each set has its own session/setup; first failure stops the run and retains completed cells. Read regression verdict/reasons separately from exitCode: pass means no elapsed regression under policy, not improvement. Observed equivalence follows the selected ordering, duplicate and nullability rules; it is not domain equivalence. Dry-run reports validation: passed, execution: not-run, and setup/baseline/candidate classifications. Per-command READ ONLY; known administrative effects denied. User functions can still have other effects, so use a least-privilege role.

subject.description: Short stable identifier for the SQL being optimized.

scope.description: SQL fragment under test, or exactly 'whole' for the full query.

setup.description: Once per measured session; setup locals do not carry into measured SQL. TEMP setup is read-write under static checks; a setup SELECT can call a user function with persistent effects, so review those functions and use a least-privilege role.

parameters.description: Scalar values: culture-invariant text or JSON null. Non-scalar parameter inputs are unsupported by this engine.

matrix.description: 2..32 distinct values for one parameter; exclusive with parameterSets/parameterSetFiles; disjoint from fixed parameters.

parameterSets.description: 2..32 named sets, matching declared types; exclusive with parameterSetFiles/matrix; disjoint from fixed parameters.

parameterSetFiles.description: 2..32 .sqljson files under input roots; entries may be scalar strings or typed objects; exclusive with parameterSets/matrix; disjoint from fixed parameters.

compareNullability.description: Require matching allowNull; otherwise reported separately. Invalid with compareResults off.

maxResultBytes.description: Result text: 4096..1048576 bytes; default 65536; capped by process limit.

maxOperationSeconds.description: Seconds 1..86400; may only lower the process limit.

dryRun.description: Offline validation only; no execution or writes.

name: sqlharness_measure
description: Measure one query across repeats. For an optimization measurement, provide both optional subject and textual scope; this is independent of compare.requireContext. Each parameter set runs on its own session with its own setup bound to that set; sets run in order and the first failure stops the run, keeping completed sets. Results report per-set stability, not cross-set equivalence. TVP and list parameter sets have no valueHash; their low-entropy values are excluded from unkeyed hashes. Per-command READ ONLY; known administrative effects denied. User functions can still have other effects, so use a least-privilege role.

setup.description: Once per measured session; setup locals do not carry into measured SQL. TEMP setup is read-write under static checks; a setup SELECT can call a user function with persistent effects, so review those functions and use a least-privilege role.

parameters.description: Scalar values: culture-invariant text or JSON null. Non-scalar parameter inputs are unsupported by this engine.

matrix.description: 2..32 distinct values for one parameter; exclusive with parameterSets/parameterSetFiles; disjoint from fixed parameters.

name: sqlharness_artifact
description: Read an existing saved artifact offline. Use its returned continuation for matrix-cells, statements, operators, or plan pages; plan nodes report omittedChildCount and omittedSubtreeCount when clipped. Sections: summary, metrics, operators, statements, matrix-cells, and plan.

id.description: Artifact directory name from a saved report.

section.description: Safe saved section. operators is capped; planShapeStable compares plan shape, not timing or row counts; null means insufficient evidence.

cursor.description: Zero-based continuation cursor for matrix-cells, statements, operators, and plan nodes.

variant.description: Plan variant: baseline, candidate, or query.

repetition.description: Measured repetition for section=plan; default is the identified last measured run. A run without a saved plan reports missing evidence, never an earlier plan.

includeText.description: Return bounded statement text and predicates in section=plan.

name: sqlharness_query
description: Run a bounded query passing the static visible-effects text check; no persistent-mutation flags are offered on this path. Hidden effects beyond the text are limited only by the DB account role prepared outside SQLHarness. Exactly one of inline sql (at most 1 MiB) or a file under an input root. A query duration is one execution's elapsed time, not benchmark evidence. Estimated plan rows are optimizer estimates; actualRows are observed rows and executions is the operator count. Dry-run reports validation: passed and execution: not-run. Per-command READ ONLY; known administrative effects denied. User functions can still have other effects, so use a least-privilege role.

name: sqlharness_plan

description: Persistent change (DML/DDL/GRANT/EXEC) on the scope's profile. Table-valued and list parameters are not supported. The operator's dashboard policy decides; the call waits up to the approval timeout. Any status other than success: stop and report; do not retry.

name: sqlharness_capabilities
description: Runtime configuration of this server: scopeMode, active compareContext policy, connectionTimeoutSeconds, engines, allowedProfiles (request scope), inputRoots (paged), processLimits, configurationRef. connectionTimeoutSeconds is the effective SQL connection/authentication timeout; Azure CLI token acquisition has a separate existing budget. Call when this connection's configuration is unknown; reuse the result for this connection and call again after a reconnect or server restart.
